verdict.rationale: Programmatic API access is a fair question for an authenticator app, since some competitors offer CLIs or APIs for managing secrets. However, nothing in the evidence documents any API for Google Authenticator. Every documented operation (sync, edit, reorder, delete, search, transfer via QR) is a mobile UI gesture. The open-source HOTP/TOTP implementations and PAM module are developer building blocks rather than an API to the app, and community reports of reading the sqlite database on a rooted phone are user-side workarounds.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
